entries.text: It begins where it ends-- in nothingness. A nightmare born from deepest fears... Coming to me unguarded, whispering images unlocked from time and distance. A soul unbound, touched by others but never held... On a course charted by some unseen hand. The journey ahead promising no more... Than my past reflected back upon me... Until, at last, I reach the end, facing a truth I can no longer deny, alone, as ever.
